# Careers at Netflix

A mirror of the Netflix careers board. Every posting is a server-rendered page
at a stable URL, so there is nothing here that needs a browser to read.

## Pages

- [Open roles](/): the whole active board. Filter with query parameters —
  `?team=Engineering`, `?type=Full+Time`, `?location=Los+Gatos`, `?q=free+text`,
  `?page=2`. Each of `team`, `type` and `q` may repeat. Every filter is in the
  URL, so any listing you can see is a link you can share.
- [A single posting](/jobs/JR41912): `/jobs/{job code}`, where the job code is
  the id printed on the posting (`JR41912`, `AJRT30201`). Case-insensitive; the
  canonical form is uppercase and anything else redirects to it.

## Data

- [The board as JSON](/api/board): every active posting as one array, newest
  first — job code, title, team, work type, locations and posting date. Business
  unit and the full description are on the posting page only, not here. This is
  the same payload the listing page filters against, so reading it
  once is strictly better than crawling the pages for the same fields.

Applications go to the official Netflix careers site, linked from the Apply
button on each posting.
